name: genome/training-overview
description: Aggregate all training data across local and grid nodes in one call. Returns adapters with loss histories, academy sessions, and per-node stats. Used by the training dashboard to avoid sequential grid/send chains from the browser.

params.name: includeGrid
params.description: Include data from remote grid nodes (default: true)

params.name: personaId
params.description: Filter to a specific persona UUID

results.name: adapters
results.description: All adapters with training metrics, loss histories, and node info

results.name: sessions
results.description: All academy sessions (active and recent completed)

results.name: nodes
results.description: Grid node summary (name, GPU, adapter count)

results.name: summary
results.description: Aggregate stats: total adapters, total sessions, best loss, avg maturity

examples.description: Get all training data across grid
